Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gio a'aalh bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gio kapbhai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gio bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'; na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh tu jiim gu vupui koi.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu Faraoon bhaan gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr kiicha' tu'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu ja'tkam maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨidhidha' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Egipkios; gio ba' gio gu Moisees ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vupui tu duukam gu Faraoon gu vupui gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ɨraab gu tukaa' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr maa'nkam mar gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam atooxkor bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar ja'tkam na tu juan bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham pai' dhuuk ka't tu' mɨɨjidha' ka't.

Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax tu' gagai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ nɨɨn; na ba' dhiñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios gu Israelitas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' jix buus guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Faraoon cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' kɨɨ'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu bɨx dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham bhañ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu oidha' gu Ejipto bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam masaa'n; gio ba' ka't dhi' na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'n masaa'n oidha' tas.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel bham; gio ba' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n mar kaneer guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat mar kaneer guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam vaak.

Gu' gu' tu' ja'tkam vaak ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jugi mar kaneer jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maa'n jurtu'nka' jugi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan mar kaneer.
Jano' ba' mar kaneer ka't cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ oidha' tas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kakneer chiiw.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ nukadham bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jugi.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jugi gu chuukug guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jugi.

Jano' ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jugi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai; gio ba' mo'o bɨɨx tɨɨt guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu gu tai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jugi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jugi guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' gu Paskua gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat gu vaak pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chɨ'ñchoka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu na ja'p guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham ka't jabka' gu vaak; na gu' no'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm kɨɨv mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh gui'x abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhɨɨya' jugi.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xumai jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xumai.

Na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh cham gu ñi'ook jabka' gu vaak na gu' no'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jugi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ali' karneer guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu novɨ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kiki'ñgob gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu gu Egipkios; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr ki'ñgob cham kiicha' baakɨi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak na ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n na ja'p juraa'n tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Paskua gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk naaka'n gu Egipkios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' ka't ɨraab gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr maa'nkam mar gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan atooxkor bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't kuupa' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix búup mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Faraoon bɨx tu duukam bɨx gu Egipkios; na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Ejipto na gu' cham ka't gu vaak pai' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tukaa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gio kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gio tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim gu oidha'; na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu'ch koko'kam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios va'k guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨidhidha' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Rameses gu Sukkot na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam a'aalh.

Jano' ba' gio jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' kakneer guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mui'x.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham jabka' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix buusñi gu Ejipto; na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Egipkios cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jugi.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Ejipto ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tanoolh moor bɨx chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu tukaa' nukadham gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' dhi' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam nukadham gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' gu Paskua; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Gu' gu' bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham jugi.
Jano' ba' gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mii' dhɨr gu chuukug mai' gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ o'o guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨndak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu chio'ñ jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'; gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ka't na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx maa'nkam mar no'x guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' xoi'kam chɨ'ñchoka' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham jugi guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abib.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Amorreo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tattat tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bii'm suudai' na jix bhai' jix duu dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨndak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' jabka' bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu mar bham; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' na ja'p nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu novɨ na ja'p chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu vupui na ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu chin; na gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oidha' tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Kananeo na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' tattat na pai' dhuuk tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaakax; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' bɨx maa'nkam mar buur guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx mar kaneer; gio ba' tu' cham jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu' tu ñi'ook gu mar bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Faraoon cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx maa'nkam mar dɨr maa'nkam mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar gu vaakax; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kuiñcha tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' na ja'p nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Faraoon guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Pilisteos ka't mia'n; na gu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio baidhak gu Moisees o'oo gu Josee ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa o'oo bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sukkot guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Etam ba'k oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat toov na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tai na ba' tu jiim; na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk ta'tak vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat toov gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn yooxi' vupui bhaan gu Piairot tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Migdol gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan gu Baalsepoon; gio ba' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Egipkios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jix duu.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu ja'tkam gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gu Israeel na ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bhɨɨ baidhak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto chɨ'ɨɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Egipkios bɨɨx bɨx kavaayo guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Faraoon gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Piairot vupui bhaan gu Baalsepoon.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Faraoon ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Egipkios aajidha' bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' cham ka't pai'm gu Ejipto jix buusñi na ba' vaak jodai oidha' jix gaki gu Por guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx no'ch jix buusñi gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' tu' a'aixkam gu Ejipto bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Egipkios tutkɨ mai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Egipkios koi no'ch oidha' jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' bɨɨx tas chɨgia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' kapbhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu i'ii'ñ gu Egipkios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kavaayo.
Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Egipkios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan yooxi' gu Israeel jix ai'chdhix tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat toov guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan jix ai'chdhix jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' gu Egipkios yooxi' gu Israeel; gio ba' ka't toov gu tukgam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moisees gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu jɨvɨl guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki ua'tulhdhidha' gu suudai' na ja'p vaak jodai kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Egipkios baap bhaan bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx kavaayo gu Faraoon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' ka't tu jiim gu xibh gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim yooxi' gu Egipkios dɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tai toov guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa yooxi' gu Egipkios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ia'lhxichulh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Egipkios gui'p; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan gu Israeel na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan gu Egipkios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' na ba' gu suudai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Egipkios bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan kavaayo.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kavɨk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Egipkios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' suulh gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kavaayo bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't kia'mi'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki ua'tulhdhidha' gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak jodai kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Egipkios; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel jix ñi' gu Egipkios koko'kam jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Israeel mii' dhɨr jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Egipkios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jiiñ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Faraoon ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn chiñia' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk; gio ba' kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan jix búup bhaan tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'iich; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p jajar.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu suudai'; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' jix buusñi gu kuchii cham tu' duu tu' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl jix bhaan dhaas gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p tu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨ'n; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch dhi' gu ja'tkam dodhia'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu kavɨk ba'bhak xidhuu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Palestina.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Edom guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Moab guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ja'p gu jodai; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk gu maa'nkar pai' gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xidhuu gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na gu' na gu' gu Faraoon chɨbiapui guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu jix gaki guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu Mariia guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Aaroon jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ moor guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' gu Mariia tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Israeel gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo moor oidha' jix gaki gu Sur; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Mara cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ i'i gu suudai' gu Mara na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Mara.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ i'i.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'u guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't tu jiim gu suudai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix maa ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan gu vupui tu jiim naak gu ñi'ook nukadham bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk matgɨm ko'kdai' tu jiim gu Egipkios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu'; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Sanador.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Elim pai' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' buusñi gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Elim bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel suudai' u'va oidha' jix gaki cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Elim gu Sinaii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mi' dhɨr moor gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix koi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix buusñi dhi' oidha' jix gaki na ba' kooda' bhiogi' bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu takarui' gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' gu tanoolh na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham.
Gu' gu' xijumai gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu xumai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu xibh chɨgia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' naak vaak jodai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na no'ch guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu'ch na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaak jodai bhaan no'ch.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu xumai gu chuukug na ba' jugi gu xibh gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak vaak jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak jodai bhaan; na no'ch guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu'ch vaak jodai cham bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios; na tu' naak vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu Aaroon bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu jiim bhaan oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ toov.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' naak vaak jodai gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jugi gu chuukug guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xumai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa novɨ maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' gu xibh jix dhaav guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix utu'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan gu vupui oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gui'p; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba' jugi.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'n bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jugi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n na ba' vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix jai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' maa'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jurtu'nka' ka't jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' gu xibh.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Moisees guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhɨt guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bhaam bhaan gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu xibh maa'n bhaan ka't jugi; gio ba' gu tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' xijumai gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jugi gook tu jiim na ba' maa'n; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees jix duu maachim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu xibh jix bhaan juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh bhaan gu Moisees ka't jix duu cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' ka't kuusdaidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ juanda' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham chɨɨmɨlhdhapu' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh juanda' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't dhɨt gu ja'tkam moor kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duu cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios jix maa juanda' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix maa xijumai gu tanoolh gu takarui' na ba' gook gu tanoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n dhi' soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga pai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix utu'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu Manaa; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu kai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix toja guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx suudai' na jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu takarui' tu' jugi oidha' jix gaki na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaaso guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix bhuup guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Testimonio na ba' nukadham na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' koi'mɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm baap gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios koi'mɨk bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' pai' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n gu Epa.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ta'tak oidha' jix gaki cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Repidim; gio ba' cham ka't gu suudai' na ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Moisees gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim gu suudai' vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Ejipto na ba' kooda' tu jiim no'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨndak daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gio gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gɨ' suudai' jiim tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' dhi' vupui bhaan tu' bhaan jodai kavɨk gu oreb; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jodai kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu suudai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios daraa gu Israeel.

Na gu' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Massa gu Meriba guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Amalek guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Israeel gu Repidim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Josuee; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu Amalek; mi' dhɨr gu xibh tu' dhi' bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.

Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Josuee na ja'p gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Amalek; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ur guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moisees gu novɨ gu Israeel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Amalek.

Jano' ba' gu noobh gu Moisees mi'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu jodai jix dhaas bɨtaa'n jix daa bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon gu ur guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu noobh maa'n baasɨ'n; jano' ba' ka't gu noobh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaas gu tas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Amalek gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' dhi' na ba' chɨ'ñchoka' u'uan tu' gu Josuee bɨx no'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨ'ñchoka' gu Amalek bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jeobaa-nissi.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu novɨ bhaan atooxkor gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Amalek jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jetro jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu Moisees bɨɨx gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix buusñi gu Israeel gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees gu Seepora gu u'vɨ gu Moisees mi' dhɨr bhañ.
Jano' ba' gook gu ma'nkam; na gu' maa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Gersom na gu' jix aa' gu Peregrino guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Elieser na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki pai' ga'ra' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jir bɨx bhai' gu Jetro guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gook gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buus guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jir bɨx bhai' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' tɨkka maa'n gu ñi'ook mi'p tɨɨtɨs vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Faraoon gu Egipkios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Israeel bɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jetro bɨx xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Egipkios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jetro; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ gu Faraoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' jano' kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Aaroon bɨx daraa gu Israeel jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh jix daa gu Moisees guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam juruuñ vupui bhaan gu Moisees dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu ja'tkam jupaabkamu'n tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk namki' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jupaabkamu'n tu'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx tu' gio dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨndak; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ tu'r guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn suulhgia' bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan mambhɨɨx gɨ' bhaan chamaam bhaan mambhɨɨx bhaan mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' ka't bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix ali'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨndak.

Jano' ba' tu' dhi' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gio bhai'x i'ii'ñ pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' tu' jix duu bɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Moisees gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx gu Israeel jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan mambhɨɨx gɨ' bhaan chamaam bhaan mambhɨɨx bhaan mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moisees guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix ali'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moisees jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vaik guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tɨɨtɨs oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Repidim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt dɨr gu kavɨk bham; mi' dhɨr daipu' gu vaak gu Jakob guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Egipkios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam naak gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat boopoya' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chumñigam bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat boopoya' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam abhaar; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Moisees jup tɨɨt daraa gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gui'p; gio ba' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda'; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' toov guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' chɨɨdaim bɨndak gio na ba' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu xibh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jajannulhi'ñ.
Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' gu tanoolh vaik na gu' vaik gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.

Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu oidha' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bham; gio ba' kɇkɇɇda' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu kavɨk tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr no'x kuichdha' gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ gu' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't gu chio'ñ cham ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr dhaibu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu ja'tkam jix bhaan duu gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jajannulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' vaik gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu u'vɨ.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't vaik gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu xibh tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ toov bhaan gu kavɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buusñi vaak ja'tkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kavɨk.

Na gu' bɨx gu kavɨk gu Sinaii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu tai; gio ba' kuubh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p kuubh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx gu kavɨk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu Moisees ua'rgidhimɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam cham bhaan gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Na gu' gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk gu Sinaii na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu Aaroon bɨndak; na gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam cham bhaan gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix dhaav gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix duu na jax chu'm tu' matgɨm na jax chu'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jiix gu tɨkɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' tu' gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' nɨidhat; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu; na gu' cham maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu bɨx tu duukam.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ tu' tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' gu vaakax tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu jiim kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham tu'x jai'ch jix utu'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' jix bhaan duu.
Jix bhaan ap tɨɨda' gu jum taat gio gu jum naan, na ap ba'x kɨɨ' oidha' bhaan gu oidha' na jum maa'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham koo'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨna'.
Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook bhaan tɨtmo ɨɨxi'ñdha' chuut.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak tɨtmo cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' gu vaakax tu' buur tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨtmo.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duu jiiñak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu' cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch na gu' cham vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios na gu' choo'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui tu ñi'ook dɨr gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu oidha' jix duu na ba' tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ pai' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' jix bhai' aa'.

Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix toja jodai jurtu'nka' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham kiicha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' no'x palhɨɨp guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Na maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix koi.
Na gu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na gu' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' matgɨm ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Na tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim tu' duuñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' i'iich guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kooda' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'vɨ ka't dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim gu ja'tkam tuumiñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gampai' bɨndak cham tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx na ja'p guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨi'chu' tɨtmo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr iiñat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨi'chu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' koox; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' duuñ tu' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' maa'n maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu vaakax kaneer; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu naan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh maa'n.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ jɨɨgi'ñdham; gio ba' cham jugi gu chuukug guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim yooxi'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ɨɨxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx cham bhai' ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ñi'ookdham ɨɨxi'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mui'x na ba' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' tu' gampai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tu' jix ai gu vaakax bhaamki'ñdha' buur guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim buur tu' bhaamki'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook kiicha' jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx jix búup.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham koo'nda' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jir bhai'; na gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' cham makia' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook bakia' gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv kiicha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jugi gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jix duu oidha' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaakax buur guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu mar ja'tkam na tu juan ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu ñi'ook boopoya' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abib; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ejipto; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ oraa' dharka' gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn yooxi'; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios oidha' tas na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiiw bɨɨx bii'm gu naan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jootsa' gu Angel vupui bhaan tu' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu bhóogɨt tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn pai' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' cham uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Gu' gu' tu' tu'r jix duu gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim bɨx tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaamki'ñdha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Angel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Amorreo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu Kananeo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' jix duu na ja'p xoi'kam; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx ko'kdai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam pai' tu' baakɨi tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mai' gu ebeo gu Kananeo gu eteo vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' oidha' tas na gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu oidha' pai' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan tu' gu vaakax yooxi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Palestina dɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu noobh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham ka't tu' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mia'n tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees suudai' u'va guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu ñi'ook gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees ua'na guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kɨkbo gu xibh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tɨɨt gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhañ biipibop gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios ali' vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ u'uan ñi'ook na jix bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga maatɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chulhiiñchuda' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ɨ'ɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm daraa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk ka't bɨtaa'n tɨɨt na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jodai na jix tɨkɨr nɨidhim gu tɨkɨr na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios koi'mɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu jiim tu' gu kavɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook ua'nak na ba' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Moisees gu Josuee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' daraa; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Aaroon gu ur bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na palhɨɨp guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk toov jix bhaan dhaas gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix utu'ñ bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii toov jix bhaan dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jup tɨɨt gu Moisees tɨjɨɨ'ñ toov.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p gu tai guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Moisees tɨjɨɨ'ñ toov jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk; gio ba' juruuñ gu Moisees gu kavɨk oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' tu' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ aagak gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chiiw.
Jano' ba' o'jo' gu chuukug guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix vɨgɨ o'jo' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'u gu Sittim.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu jodai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix uam jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga iiñat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim iiñat tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chuut tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'u gu Sittim jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai bɨɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ meesa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan meesa gu takarui' tɨkiix vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu kavɨk.
