Jano' ba' gu takarui' cham jabka' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham jabka' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' tu'x jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tiriik.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx tuur gook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Aaroon kutun na jix toja guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan mo'o bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios abhaar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kutun na jix toja.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu noobh gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tuur vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur.
Jano' ba' koo'nda' tuur vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr tuur guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gio bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai mai' yooxi' gu chuukug tuur guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' koo'nda' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook bapaalh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan mo'o.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' koo'nda' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam naak jix duu gu Aaroon bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Aaroon bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn suulhgia'; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu; na gu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu takarui' jajar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu noobh gu Aaroon gu noobh gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu noobh jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn baaso gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't makgɨrta na ba' gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baaso gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga u'uañ ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.

Na gu' ka't na ba' gu Aaroon na ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Aaroon ka't gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam pai' daraibu' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xidhuu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chuukug pai' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jugi gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' jix duu jugi mii' dhɨr tu'x bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu noobh na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' gu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn abhaar.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn abhaar.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan tuur guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhaibu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' jix bhaan duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' no'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kuichdha' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gook ali' karneer oidha' tas gu tanoolh cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Oprekeraas mar kaneer gu xibh mar kaneer guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu xumai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n gu Epa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' u'va bɨɨx mar kaneer.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mar kaneer guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu xumai guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' gu maa'nkar gu xibh jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' ka't gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel pai' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gu u'u gu Sittim jix duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't novɨ maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' ka't jix duu; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' a'aa' ka't.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ a'aa'; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kuruun jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix uam jodai bɨtaa'n kuruun gook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx ka't baabuk.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu noobh tɨɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu suudai' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tai.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu noobh tɨɨt cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu kai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xidhuu bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨ'ñdhatu' abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ choi' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut.
Jano' ba' meesa bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mɨichdhai bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' bɨx kuichdha' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gio gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' ka't bɨ'ñdhatu' abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu chuukug gu chio'ñ cham ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ nɨidhim jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na jix bhai' abhaar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' tɨɨgim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut iiñat bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' meesa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mɨichdhai na jix bhai' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ ii'mdagaram.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' ju'ñdharan tu' dhi' bhaan jodai kavɨk.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jodai kavɨk tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu novɨ bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku ua'na' bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook mi'p guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tumiiñku guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' gu xibh tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh gu kavɨk gu Sinaii guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu chio'ñ bɨndak tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'ñdha' bɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' tu' kakneer tu' gu vaakax guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku; gio ba' jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Sinaii na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav toov juruuñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'r.

Na jix nukadham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mo'o bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu Jawatan gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' gu Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' na cham jir bhai' chulhiiñdha' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨ'p cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu oidha' tu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨndak.

Jano' ba' jix nukadham tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo.

Na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' pai' baakɨi na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Na gu' na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Keloso gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jugi makgɨrxi'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abib; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abib guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu vaakax bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kaneer ua'tulhi'ñ gu chio'ñ.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx mar kaneer guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ buur; gio ba' tu' cham jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mo'o; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam cham ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oraa'.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' tiriik; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oidha' tas.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oidha' tas ka't buupui bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Señoreador gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha'; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk tu' tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buupui vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaik mui'kim pai' tas.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tukaa' na ba' gu xibh gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gakdhi'ñchix.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chiiw bii'm gu naan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jurtu'nka' dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak bɨɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham jix jugi gu takarui' tu' jix i'i gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr ua'na guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bɨɨx gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios chuut gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨmñim gu kavɨk cham bhai'x guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vupui guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr ka't bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Moisees guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vupui ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ jix duu.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Aaroon bɨx chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ suulh gu Moisees tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gu Moisees ñiokda' bɨɨx jix dhaas tu jiim bhaan gu vupui.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ñiokda' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm busaak; gio ba' gamai' ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ka't jix duu.

Jano' ba' tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vupui gu Moisees guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vupui ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim bhaan gu vupui bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ñiokda' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam gu' gu tanoolh kɨɨv ka't jix bhaan juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'x guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tanoolh juanda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu maa'nkar na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ñakaabma' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chiiw.
Jano' ba' o'jo' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chuukug o'jo' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'u gu Sittim.

Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu jodai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mui' jodai na jix bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix maat gu i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ɨlhdham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan vaak zel iiñat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix duu iiñat tu jiim vaak zel.
Jano' ba' meesa jix duu bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu takarui' tɨkiix.
Jano' ba' mɨichdhai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix duu bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ki'ñgob na ba' ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix duu bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam suudai' buusñi bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xidhuu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix buus bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' iiñat tɨɨt guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chuukug iiñat tɨɨt guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xidhuu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
